`RESULTS.json` is written. Summary of the quarter (May–July 2026):

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Costs | €467,940 |
| Net | €765,285 (62.1% margin) |
| Net customer adds | 153 (223 new − 70 churned) |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% (956 / 1,001) |
| June MoM growth | +4.6% |
| July MoM growth | −9.6% |

One judgment call to be aware of: **June's report is internally inconsistent** — its cost table sums to €158,540 but the stated total is €158,240 (€300 apart). May and July tie out exactly. I used the line-item sums, so the quarterly figures reflect €158,540; the notes field records the alternative values had the stated total been used (margin still rounds to 62.1% either way). The notes also flag the softening trend: new signings fell each month (86→74→63) while churn rose (17→22→31), with July revenue down 9.6%.
